source.stem:
The table shows the conditions in four test-tubes containing equal amounts of starch and salivary amylase.
In which test-tube is the starch broken down fastest?

intelligence.enrichment: In the protein test, a violet colour after adding copper sulphate solution and caustic soda solution indicates the presence of proteins in the food item. protein-test chemicals added to prepared food sample and violet colour appears -> protein is present The learner correctly applies this rule: In the protein test, a violet colour after adding copper sulphate solution and caustic soda solution indicates the presence of proteins in the food item. Any added laboratory chemical proves protein even if the violet colour does not appear.
